title: PSM MOC Record
description: Evidence model for Management of Change (MOC) records per OSHA-KR Article 44. v1 aligned with GMP change-control pattern.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the MOC record

change_id.description: Unique identifier for the change request

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Primary: OSHA-KR Article 44 (PSM — management of change). Adjacent laws may include: SAPA Article 4 (change management as part of safety system), OSHA-KR Article 38 (safety measures before work), Occupational Safety and Health Standards Rule Article 92 (equipment isolation for changes).
examples: 안전보건기준에관한규칙 Article 92 (정비 등 작업 시 운전정지 등)

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the record was created

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that generated this record

assessment_type.description: Type of hazard assessment performed (e.g. HAZOP, What-if, FMEA)

completed_by.description: ID of the person who completed the hazard review

completion_date.description: Date when the hazard review was completed

hazard_ref.description: Optional (v2.1.0): cross-references from this MOC's hazard_review.findings to formal finding records (id pattern per _shared/base/finding.schema.json). Each entry is a FIND-YYYY-NNNN record raised from the review; free-text findings remain in hazard_review.findings — this field adds traceability, it does not replace them.

corrective_action_ref.description: Optional (v2.1.0): cross-references to corrective-action records (id pattern per _shared/base/corrective-action.schema.json) that close the findings listed in hazard_ref. MOC closure requires every referenced corrective action to reach 'verified' status.

role.description: Approver role (e.g. Process Engineer, Safety Manager, Plant Manager)
